lines.text: Get up! Get UP! The day ain't gonna grind itself!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [shouting] Get up! Get UP! The day ain't gonna grind itself!

lines.text: Coffee. Shower. Domination. In that order. Let's go!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [fast] Coffee. Shower. Domination. In that order. Let's go!

lines.text: You feel that? That's the fire, baby! Feed it!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [excited] You feel that? That's the fire, baby! Feed it!

lines.text: Nobody's handin' you nothin'. So you go out there and you TAKE it!
lines.elevenlabs_text: Nobody's handin' you nothin'. So you go out there and you TAKE it!

lines.text: Tired? Tired's for mooks! You ain't a mook!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [shouting] Tired? Tired's for mooks! You ain't a mook!

lines.text: Snooze button? Fuhgeddaboudit. Feet on the floor. Now!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [annoyed] Snooze button? Fuhgeddaboudit. Feet on the floor. Now!

lines.text: One more rep! Then another one! Then I'll tell ya when to stop!
lines.elevenlabs_text: [laughs] One more rep! Then another one! Then I'll tell ya when to stop!

lines.text: Every mornin', you wake up hungry. That's how empires get built.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [slowly] Every mornin', you wake up hungry. That's how empires get built.

lines.text: I started with nothin'. Nothin'. You got more than I had. Use it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: I started with nothin'. Nothin'. You got more than I had. Use it.

lines.text: Comfort's a trap, kid. The work? The work sets you free.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sighs] Comfort's a trap, kid. The work? The work sets you free.

lines.text: Discipline. Loyalty. Hustle. You do those three, you never go hungry.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Discipline. Loyalty. Hustle. You do those three, you never go hungry.

lines.text: Sweat now, or bleed later. Your choice.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [clears throat] Sweat now, or bleed later. Your choice.

lines.text: Show up every day. That's ninety percent of it. The rest is guts.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Show up every day. That's ninety percent of it. The rest is guts.

lines.text: Rise and grind, sweetheart. And look good doin' it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [chuckles] Rise and grind, sweetheart. And look good doin' it.

lines.text: Winners don't wait for the mood. They make the mood.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [warmly] Winners don't wait for the mood. They make the mood.

lines.text: Dress like you already own the place. Then go buy it.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [mischievously] Dress like you already own the place. Then go buy it.

lines.text: Big day ahead. Stand up straight. Walk in like you belong.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [softly] Big day ahead. Stand up straight. Walk in like you belong.

lines.text: Smile at the competition. Then outwork 'em. That's style.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Smile at the competition. Then outwork 'em. That's style.

lines.text: Everybody else is sleepin'. You know what that means? We're already winnin'.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [suspicious] Everybody else is sleepin'. You know what that means? We're already winnin'.

lines.text: The early bird gets the worm. And I'm tellin' ya, I love worms.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [whispers] The early bird gets the worm. And I'm tellin' ya, I love worms.

lines.text: Oh, you're gonna skip the gym? Sure. And I'm the Pope.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [sarcastic] Oh, you're gonna skip the gym? Sure. And I'm the Pope.

lines.text: Doubters? Let 'em talk. Then let 'em watch.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [scoffs] Doubters? Let 'em talk. Then let 'em watch.

lines.text: Hair done, shoes shined, attitude locked in. Now we go to work.
lines.elevenlabs_text: Hair done, shoes shined, attitude locked in. Now we go to work.

lines.text: Ohhh! Look at this one! Up before the sun!
lines.elevenlabs_text: Ohhh! [excited] Look at this one! Up before the sun!

lines.text: Pressure makes diamonds, kid. And you? You're a diamond.
lines.elevenlabs_text: [slowly] Pressure makes diamonds, kid. And you? You're a diamond.
